title: Common-stage Hom linear-equivalence predicate
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme $T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Let $S$ be the framework stage system and $S.\mathrm{PairCategory}$ its literal coefficient pair category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let $P=\mathrm{pbcScalarSystem}$ be the ordinary PBC system [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category], with its $\Omega$-linear pair category [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. Let $J:S\to P$ be a coherent stage-system morphism, with each $J_E=J.\Phi_E$ an equivalence. Its comparison is $\beta_h:P_hJ_E\xrightarrow{\sim}J_LS_h$ for $h:E\le L$.
Define $\operatorname{FdHomLinearEquivalence}(\ell,\Omega,T,J)$ as the following proposition. For pairs $A=(E,K)$, $B=(F,H)$ and every common finite field $M\supset E,F$, there exist additive bijections $s_{A,B,M}:\operatorname{Hom}(A_M,B_M)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}((JA)_M,(JB)_M)$. They send $u$ to $\beta_{M/F,H}^{-1}\circ J_M(u)\circ\beta_{M/E,K}$, and their inverses send $v$ to the unique preimage under $J_M$ of $\beta_{M/F,H}\circ v\circ\beta_{M/E,K}^{-1}$. For every $M\subset N$, both these maps and their inverses commute with the actual associator-conjugated transport of the pair categories. There exist $\Omega$-linear bijections $h_{A,B}:\operatorname{Hom}(A,B)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}(JA,JB)$ whose forward map is $J.\mathrm{functor}.\mathrm{map}$, with $h([M,u])=[M,s_M(u)]$ and $h^{-1}([M,v])=[M,s_M^{-1}(v)]$. The induced functor is additive and $\Omega$-linear and has object formula $J(E,K)=(E,J_EK)$. Every $A_E$ in the target stage has a preimage $K$ at that same field and an isomorphism $J_EK\cong A_E$.
For every choice of preimages $K_A$ at each target pair's own field and isomorphisms $\epsilon_A:J_{E_A}K_A\cong A_{E_A}$, there exists an equivalence $e:S.\mathrm{PairCategory}\simeq P.\mathrm{PairCategory}$ whose forward functor is this induced functor; both functors are additive and $\Omega$-linear. Its inverse sends $A$ to $(E_A,K_A)$ and sends $f:A\to B$ to $h^{-1}(\iota_{E_B}(\epsilon_B^{-1})\circ f\circ\iota_{E_A}(\epsilon_A))$, using the Hom bijection at the two chosen preimage pairs. Its counit at $A$ is exactly $\iota_{E_A}(\epsilon_A)$. Finally, the forward functor commutes with the specified finite-stage inclusions on objects and arrows: $J\iota_E^S(K)=\iota_E^P(J_EK)$ and $J(\iota_E^S(f))=\iota_E^P(J_E(f))$. All categories, transport and scalar actions in this predicate are those just cited; no new category or Karoubi envelope is chosen.
